statements.status_notes: Docker Scout reports CVE-2026-101273 for the Alpine iperf3 <3.22-r0 auth-fix range; the CVE Program has no CVE-2026-101273 record (canonical id CVE-2026-101283). The DHI iperf3 3.20-r1 and 3.19.1-r2 APKs include the same upstream fix at https://github.com/esnet/iperf/commit/d08588aceee48fa45832cae5e32616abb33cb0fc.

The DHI iperf3 3.20-r1 and 3.19.1-r2 APKs backport the server_timer_proc() heap use-after-free fix from iperf 3.22 (https://github.com/esnet/iperf/releases/tag/3.22), including https://github.com/esnet/iperf/commit/d58ad3d6014ba9217c95031f8937cda39e5b3d61. The per-test watchdog cancels and joins stream workers before freeing them. Advisory: https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2026-101276

The DHI iperf3 3.20-r1 and 3.19.1-r2 APKs backport JSON get_parameters validation from upstream iperf PR https://github.com/esnet/iperf/pull/2039 (commit https://github.com/esnet/iperf/commit/494dd377eca4689672becdf06a85158557db1586), including the post-parse MAX_BLOCKSIZE and UDP min/max checks. Advisory: https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2026-71217

The DHI iperf3 3.20-r1 and 3.19.1-r2 APKs backport the UDP receive worker infinite-loop fix from iperf 3.22 (https://github.com/esnet/iperf/commit/a25378f8cbbaa7b3db5674ca3dcc19658ae65da3) and reject a zero or out-of-range remote len inside get_parameters (https://github.com/esnet/iperf/commit/494dd377eca4689672becdf06a85158557db1586). Advisory: https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2026-102253

The DHI iperf3 3.20-r1 and 3.19.1-r2 APKs backport the decrypt_rsa_message() pre-auth heap buffer overflow fix from iperf 3.22 (https://github.com/esnet/iperf/commit/d08588aceee48fa45832cae5e32616abb33cb0fc). On 3.19.1 the hunk applies after aports openssl-3.5.3.patch, which introduces the output_buffer_len check this commit tightens. Advisory: https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2026-101283
